faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about admissions, classes, and distance learning.
faq1Q: What is the difference between Regular and Distance learning?
faq1A: Regular classes are held in-person at church premises on weekends or evenings. Distance learning is a 100% online LMS accessible globally.
faq2A: Any Orthodox Christian believer aged 14 and above can enroll. Regular students join Grade 7–12 batches; distance students complete modular courses.
faq3A: Yes! Upon finishing all coursework and assessments, students receive a digital QR-verifiable certificate and an official printed diploma.
faq4A: You can transfer via CBE Bank or Telebirr and simply upload your transaction slip on the registration portal.
aboutParagraph1: Tekle Sawiros Sunday School is a historic, apostolic sanctuary under St. Lideta Lemaryam Church in Addis Ababa.
aboutParagraph2: We offer systematic biblical education, Orthodox theology, and sacred Ge'ez chants (Zema) for children, youth, and adults.
classesSubheading: Carefully structured spiritual education designed for biblical wisdom and Christian maturity.

grade12Desc: Orthodox theology, apologetics, and apostolic service.
